title: POST /books not exposed by the served app
evidence: main.py declares only @app.get('/health') (main.py:22) and @app.get('/books') (main.py:26); no @app.post. create_book() at book_api.py:24 exists but book_api is never imported by main.py (grep 'book_api' returns nothing) and is bound to no router.
suggestion: Add an @app.post('/books', status_code=201) route in main.py that validates and persists a book (wire it to book_api.create_book).

title: GET /books ?author= filter not implemented in served app
evidence: main.py:27 get_books() takes no query param and runs 'SELECT * FROM books' unconditionally (main.py:30). book_api.get_all_books() supports an author filter (book_api.py:47) but is unrouted.
suggestion: Add an 'author: str | None = None' query param to the served GET /books route and filter by it.

title: GET /books/{id} not exposed by the served app
evidence: No @app.get('/books/{id}') in main.py. get_book_by_id() at book_api.py:57 is unrouted and book_api is not imported.
suggestion: Add an @app.get('/books/{book_id}') route returning one book (404 if absent).

title: PUT /books/{id} not exposed by the served app
evidence: No @app.put in main.py. update_book() at book_api.py:70 is unrouted and book_api is not imported.
suggestion: Add an @app.put('/books/{book_id}') route that updates an existing book.

title: DELETE /books/{id} not exposed by the served app
evidence: No @app.delete in main.py. delete_book() at book_api.py:114 is unrouted and book_api is not imported.
suggestion: Add an @app.delete('/books/{book_id}', status_code=204) route that deletes a book.

title: GET /books returns raw tuples and only 200; no 201/404/400 codes
evidence: main.py:33 returns cursor.fetchall() (a list of raw tuples, not JSON objects with column names). Only GET /health and GET /books exist, both default 200; no 201/404/400 status codes are produced anywhere in the served app.
suggestion: Return dict-shaped rows and set appropriate status codes on the create/get-by-id/update/delete routes once added.

title: No input validation (title/author required) in the served API
evidence: main.py has no POST route and no Pydantic model; the served app never validates input. The NOT NULL constraint at book_api.py:15 is never reached over HTTP and yields no 400.
suggestion: Add a Pydantic request model (title/author required) to the POST route so invalid input returns 422/400.

title: test_book_api.py exercises endpoints the served app does not expose
evidence: test_book_api.py POSTs (line 23), GETs by id (line 55), PUTs (line 74) and DELETEs (line 98) against the live uvicorn server, but main:app only serves GET /health and GET /books; those requests hit 404/405. test_coverage=0.25 in scores.json reflects the resulting failures.
suggestion: Implement the missing routes in main.py so the integration tests pass.
